params.name: Dynamics
params.desc: Set the amount of compression.

params.name: Sensitivity
params.desc: Sets the dynamic threshold. The higher the knob is turned up, the more sensitive Clean becomes.

params.name: Wet
params.desc: Controls the loudness of the processed signal.

params.name: Attack
params.desc: Controls how quickly the compression will set in.

params.name: EQ
params.desc: The counter-clockwise side removes highs while the clockwise side removes lows. At noon, the EQ will have no effect.

params.name: Dry
params.desc: Controls the loudness of the unprocessed signal.

params.name: Ramp Speed
params.desc: If ramping is enabled, this controls the ramping speed.

params.name: Release
params.desc: Controls how quickly the compression (and left EQ mode) will fade out.

params.name: Mode
params.desc: Selects the EQ mode.

params.name: Physics
params.desc: Manipulates the physical behaviour of Clean's dynamic response.

params.name: Bypass
params.desc: Turns off/on Clean.

params.name: Swell
params.desc: Engages a swell effect.

params.name: Alt Menu
params.usage: 0: Exit ALT Menu; 1-127: Enter ALT Menu
params.desc: Enters/exits the Hidden Menu.

params.name: Dynamics Max
params.desc: Maxes out Clean's (dynamic) sag effect.

params.name: Expression over MIDI
params.desc: Sets the expression value over MIDI.

params.name: Preset Save
params.desc: Save preset to specified slot.

params.name: Noise Gate Release
params.desc: Sets how quickly the noise gate will re-engage.

params.name: Noise Gate Threshold
params.desc: Sets the threshold for Clean's noise gate.

params.name: Swell In
params.desc: Sets how long it takes to reach full volume when Swell is engaged.

params.name: User Release
params.desc: Allows you to set a custom value for the middle RELEASE position.

params.name: Balance Filter
params.desc: Lets you filter out low frequencies from the audio being used to control Clean's dynamic response.

params.name: Swell Out
params.desc: Sets how long it takes to return to silence when Swell is engaged.

params.name: Envelope Mode
params.desc: Selects which type of envelope follower Clean uses.

params.name: Shifty Mode
params.desc: Selects the EQ's Shifty mode.

params.name: Spread Routing
params.desc: Lets you independently assign SPREAD to the EQ or volume-based effects (Compressor & Swell).

params.name: Dynamics
params.desc: Toggles ramping of the Dynamics knob.

params.name: Attack
params.desc: Toggles ramping of the Attack knob.

params.name: EQ
params.desc: Toggles ramping of the EQ knob.

params.name: Dry
params.desc: Toggles ramping of the Dry knob.

params.name: Wet
params.desc: Toggles ramping of the Wet knob.

params.name: Bounce
params.desc: Toggles ramping of the Bounce knob.

params.name: Sweep
params.desc: Selects the direction of the Sweep.

params.name: Polarity
params.desc: Selects the polarity of the Sweep.

params.name: MISO
params.desc: Splits a mono input signal into a stereo output signal.

params.name: Spread
params.desc: Engages stereo processing.

params.name: Latch
params.desc: Change the hold function for each footswitch from momentary to latching.

params.name: Sidechain
params.desc: Allows you to use an external signal to trigger the compression.

params.name: Noise Gate
params.desc: Activates a noise gate that will mute the input when you're not playing.

params.name: Motion
params.desc: Engages a special "motion mode" that modulates the amount of compression being applied.

params.name: Swell Aux
params.desc: Changes the function of the AUX footswitch to allow for manual swells.

params.name: Dusty
params.desc: Transforms the limiter inside of Clean to a distinct form of crumbly overdrive.
